name: @yottameta/yotta-mirror
description: YuanJing (yotta-mirror) — a local, deterministic learning-diagnostics skill for AI agents: reads a CSV / TSV score or answer sheet plus an item-to-knowledge map, runs a data gate, per-item statistics, score-weighted knowledge mastery, student layers with borderline detection, and weak-point diagnosis, then writes a Markdown / JSON report in which every conclusion carries its item ids, sample size, rate and the threshold used. Configurable thresholds, reproducible student anonymisation and a CI gate are included. Triggers: analysing class scores or homework accuracy, finding weak knowledge points, producing a learning-diagnostics report, checking layer distribution and borderline students, or wiring diagnostics into automation. Boundaries: deterministic local statistics and teaching-improvement hints only — no student comments, rankings or admission predictions, no labelling of students; no network access, no model calls, no student-data upload, no cross-device sync; no OCR for images or scanned papers; results do not replace teacher judgement, and low-sample or borderline cases are downgraded to human review. Fully local, zero-dependency (Python 3.8+ standard library).
